13:15.race_name: Castle Windows Newbury Anniversary Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: A Peltier D Juste & J Houdin
runners.comment: Has built up a solid record at about 2m; ran well in the Dovecote most recently
runners.name: Kocktail Bleu
runners.spotlight: Has built up a solid record when racing at about 2m under rules, as form figures of 222 this year help to demonstrate; ran well in the Dovecote at Kempton (good to soft) most recently; leading player back down in class.

runners.comment: Brings strong form; beaten only a whisker dropped back to 2m last time; respected
runners.name: Lisbane Park
runners.spotlight: Brings strong form, having made the frame in races won by the subsequent EBF Final and Supreme winners; beaten only a whisker at Exeter, the scene of his November win, dropped back to 2m last time; respected.

runners.comment: Latest Flat effort (stable debut) is notable form; brings potential to this code
runners.name: Gambino
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish unexposed sort whose Flat form comprises a success and two placed efforts, latest on debut for new stable in the AW novice event won by Constitution Hill; brings potential to this code and looks interesting.

runners.comment: Twice-raced 6yo who may yet confirm the promise of his 2023 bumper win
runners.name: Giddyupadingdong
runners.spotlight: Twice-raced 6yo who was possibly unsuited by soft going switched to hurdles three months ago; had wind surgery since; may yet confirm the promise of his good-ground bumper success in 2023.

runners.comment: Holds weak claims on form
runners.name: King Berry
runners.spotlight: Holds weak claims on bumper and hurdles form; should find handicaps more suitable shortly.

runners.comment: Rules form leaves a lot to be desired
runners.name: Noble Don
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in the point-to-point sphere in 2023 but two rules efforts (in 2024 and 2026) leave a lot to be desired.

runners.comment: Pair of duck eggs next to his name
runners.name: Padel Bandit
runners.spotlight: Pair of duck eggs next to his name; best watched.

runners.comment: Prevailed in juvenile hurdle over C&D last time; interesting at the weights
runners.name: Cecilia Star
runners.spotlight: Flat scorer who has raced twice over hurdles, looking value for a bit more than the neck winning margin in juvenile event over C&D (good to soft) latest having idled in front; interesting contender at the weights.

13:50.race_name: Get Best Odds Guaranteed At BetVictor Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: 2nd of five in Doncaster handicap (extended 2m3f) two runs ago; needs to resume progress
runners.name: Storming George
runners.spotlight: Met with heavy defeats in a Grade 1 three starts back and a Grade 2 on latest but progressive form in his other three hurdle races, second of five in a handicap at Doncaster (extended 2m3f) on penultimate outing; needs to resume progress.

runners.comment: Tongue tied when running poorly last time and had wind surgery soon afterwards
runners.name: Fresh Perspective
runners.spotlight: Possibly best left-handed; either way, he ran poorly at right-handed Huntingdon last time, when some moderate jumps did not help; tongue tied that day (but not today) and had wind surgery soon afterwards; consistent form over hurdles before that run but needs better on this handicap debut.

runners.comment: Pulled up at Kelso latest but he was 28-1 in that Grade 2 and retains some interest
runners.name: Red Oak
runners.spotlight: Won maiden at Musselburgh (2m4f, soft) in December and good second at Catterick (2m3f, good to soft) next time; pulled up at Kelso three weeks ago but he was 28-1 in that Grade 2 and retains some interest for this handicap debut.

runners.comment: Longer trips will surely suit in due course but he's a useful prospect, at the least
runners.name: Grand Vendetta
runners.spotlight: Useful pedigree; second at Chepstow (good to soft) in December on debut and asserted late on in a novice at Taunton (heavy; at 4-5) in early February; both were over an extended 2m3f and longer trips than that will surely be his thing in due course, but he's a useful prospect (at the least) and probably on a favourable opening mark.

runners.comment: Comfortably on top in a 2m4f maiden at Hereford (soft; worst result was on good) last time
runners.name: Glancing Jack
runners.spotlight: Ran at Hereford for bumper win and both hurdle races, comfortably on top in a 2m4f maiden (soft; worst result was on good) last time; this handicap debut demands plenty more but he's lightly raced and should retain potential.

runners.comment: Won two of four hurdle races, 2nd in the others; makes handicap debut on a reasonable mark
runners.name: Kapitein Kool
runners.spotlight: 0-3 in bumpers but he's won two of his four hurdle races and been runner-up in the others; second at Taunton (good) on penultimate start showed he stays 2m3f, before his narrow win at Exeter (2m, heavy) on latest; makes handicap debut on a reasonable mark.

runners.comment: Seemingly stretched when he tried 2m4f; hurdling score is 1-7 and he may prove vulnerable
runners.name: Doctors Hill
runners.spotlight: Has seen much more action than most of this field and took a novice at Chepstow (2m, soft) in November; second in handicap here (2m, good to soft) was the clear best of his last three outings (seemingly stretched by 2m4f the time before) and this looks a competitive mark, but his hurdling score is 1-7 and he may well prove vulnerable to an improver.

runners.comment: Early days but markedly better is needed; poor show on handicap debut (near 2m2f, heavy)
runners.name: The Boss Bear
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden at Plumpton (2m5f, good to soft) in December on hurdling debut; put firmly in his place next time, while appearing to run creditably, and needs to bounce back from a poor show on handicap debut at Fontwell (near 2m2f, heavy) four weeks ago; early days but markedly better is needed.

runners.comment: Drew 12l clear for breakthrough win at Doncaster (extended 2m3f, good to soft); up 8lb
runners.name: Diamond Koda
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in nine of his first 14 races, before finally off the mark when well backed for 12-runner handicap at Doncaster (extended 2m3f, good to soft) three weeks ago in second-time cheekpieces; drew 12l clear for that breakthrough but this 8lb higher mark seems to demand another step forward.

runners.comment: Progressive juvenile hurdler; this longer trip could suit him very well on handicap debut
runners.name: Thewoodcorner
runners.spotlight: 2m win on his second French Flat start; progressive form in his three forays over hurdles for new connections, notably when winning at Chepstow (2m, soft) and runner-up at Huntingdon (2m, good to soft) in another juvenile event; this longer trip could suit him very well on handicap debut.

14:25.race_name: BetVictor Home Of The Saturday Superboost Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Hindered by being unable to dominate last time; chance hinges on getting an easy lead
runners.name: Twinjets
runners.spotlight: Two wins from the front, including a defeat of Heltenham over C&D, and two non-completions comprise a mixed current campaign; hindered by being unable to dominate in the Greatwood Gold Cup last time; chance may depend on whether he gets an easy lead.

runners.comment: Has a doubt over current form; second start for new stable
runners.name: Hercule Du Seuil
runners.spotlight: Useful on his day for Willie Mullins but form has dipped this winter, most recently last of four finishers at Doncaster where he was the rank outsider on debut for new yard; best watched unless the market signals go the other way.

runners.comment: Very attractively treated on historical data, which includes Grade 2 wins; one to consider
runners.name: Knappers Hill
runners.owner: Chris & Giles Barber And P J Vogt
runners.spotlight: Heavy ground provides an excuse for latest effort; has hinted at retaining ability otherwise since returning from lengthy layoff; very attractively treated on historical data, which includes four Grade 2 wins (bumper/hurdles/fences); one to consider.

runners.comment: Suited by this C&D; back to form in the Greatwood Gold Cup; won this race in 2023 and 2024
runners.name: Heltenham
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late N W Lake
runners.spotlight: Back to something like his best last time, registering a second success in the Greatwood Gold Cup and taking C&D record to 4-6; won this contest in 2023 and 2024; back up the weights but commands respect kept to a scenario that suits him ideally.

runners.comment: Has looked as good as ever in winning two of his last three races; likely player
runners.name: Prairie Wolf
runners.owner: G R Orchard & Mrs J M Gray
runners.spotlight: Northern runner who has looked as good as ever in winning two of his last three races, taking chase record to 6-18; did it quite readily at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) latest; ran respectably at Newbury in November; likely player in current form.

runners.comment: Good second in this race last year, prior to beating Heltenham at Newton Abbot
runners.name: Scarface
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent this season but has finished a good second on two occasions (November/December) and filled the same position in this race 12 months ago prior to beating Heltenham at Newton Abbot; well capable of posing a threat, provided he's back to form.

runners.comment: Absent for 22 months; faller in two of his four chase attempts; comes with risk
runners.name: Authorised Speed
runners.spotlight: On an attractive mark but comes with risk, having fallen in two of his four attempts over fences and been absent since performing below market expectations at Warwick 22 months ago; the betting may offer further guidance.

runners.comment: Saved for spring ground; scored under Sean Bowen on penultimate appearance
runners.name: Coastguard Station
runners.spotlight: Absent since suffering a heavy defeat over 3m in November; seemingly saved for spring ground and could go well with Sean Bowen back on board; sole attempt under this rider resulted in Market Rasen success (2m5f) on penultimate start.

15:00.race_name: BetVictor British EBF "National Hunt" Mares' Novices' Hurdle (Limited Handicap) (Grade 2) (GBB)

runners.comment: Has top weight on this handicap debut but this new trip could prove just the ticket
runners.name: Charisma Cat
runners.spotlight: 3-5 in bumpers, including a Sandown Listed win on good to soft; won at Chepstow (2m, soft) on third attempt over hurdles and runner-up in the other three; cheekpieces latest (ran creditably); has top weight on this handicap debut but going beyond 2m1f for first time could prove just the ticket.

runners.comment: Fluffed the final flight last time; open to further progress on this handicap debut
runners.name: Bettys Daisy
runners.spotlight: Tongue tied and made most when clearcut winner at Ludlow (2m5f) and excellent second of 16 at Warwick (2m3f, again good to soft); fluffing the final flight relinquished the initiative last time (Edith Pelham third, Shotgun Shirley fourth) and she's open to further progress on this handicap debut.

runners.comment: Ran well behind Charisma Cat latest; has more to offer, including at this longer trip
runners.name: Watamu
runners.spotlight: Won at Huntingdon on penultimate start; soundly beaten behind Charisma Cat in a Listed race here the time before but put up a far better show against that rival when they were placed at Market Rasen on latest outing; they are closely matched judged on latest result and she has more to offer, including at this longer trip.

runners.comment: Never got to grips with two of today's rivals latest (2m) but one to note given her yard
runners.name: Getawhisky
runners.spotlight: Marked improvement to win at Windsor in January in her third hurdle race; came from off the pace when fourth of nine at Market Rasen (again 2m, soft) and never got to grips with today's rivals Charisma Cat and Watamu, a result which leaves her with something to find but this is a different trip and her trainer is a dab hand at big handicap wins.

runners.breeder: Earl De Cordelles & Earl La Dariole
runners.comment: Already a 2m5f winner before she won at Wincanton (1m7f) 16 days ago; handicap debut
runners.name: Indannya
runners.spotlight: Won at Warwick (2m5f, good to soft; from Fresh As A Daisy) on second start under rules; floundered in Grade 2 on heavy there next time but no ill effects, as she asserted on run-in at Wincanton (1m7f, good to soft) 16 days ago; back up in trip for this handicap debut and remains capable of better.

runners.comment: Going the right way over hurdles (2m4f/2m5f); this is a strong race for handicap debut
runners.name: Strong Run
runners.spotlight: Did well in bumpers and going the right way over hurdles, on last two starts winning at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft) and second at Wincanton (2m5f, heavy); needs further progress in this good race for handicap debut.

runners.comment: Won at Southwell (2m5f, soft) latest, battling back after a bad mistake at final flight
runners.name: Edith Pelham
runners.spotlight: Trailed several of today's rivals at Market Rasen in her second hurdle race but showed that to be all wrong when winning at Southwell (2m5f, soft) 19 days ago, battling back after a bad mistake at the final flight; better is needed for this handicap debut and cheekpieces are added.

runners.breeder: N J Henderson And Mrs S A Aston
runners.comment: Chased home Indannya at Warwick (2m5f) last time; more to offer on this handicap debut
runners.name: Fresh As A Daisy
runners.spotlight: Made a winning hurdle debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good) last May and put reappearance behind her when chasing home Indannya at Warwick (2m5f, good to soft) on New Year's Eve; more to offer on this handicap debut.

runners.comment: Work to do but strong impression of long-term potential, including over this longer trip
runners.name: Trinity Street
runners.spotlight: Three runs over hurdles, all in the mud and her best result when second to Charisma Cat at Chepstow (2m, soft) in January; made most when well beaten behind her and several more of today's rivals at Market Rasen on latest start; major work to do but she leaves one of the strongest impressions of long-term potential, including over this longer trip.

runners.breeder: G Durrheim And Maria Mulcahy Durrheim
runners.comment: 1-9 hurdling; 5lb lower than when 4th under M Dodd at Cheltenham December, her best form
runners.name: Pismo Beach
runners.spotlight: Held up; 1-9 over hurdles but 5lb lower than when fourth under Murray Dodd at Cheltenham (2m4f, good to soft) in December, her best form; no match for Indannya or Fresh As A Daisy at Warwick next time, but her latest start (pulled up at Ludlow; tongue tied first time) is the chief worry.

runners.comment: Much further behind Edith Pelham at Southwell last time; early days for handicap debutante
runners.name: Shotgun Shirley
runners.spotlight: Progressed well in bumpers and ran encouragingly behind Betty's Daisy and Edith Pelham when fourth of 16 at Warwick (2m3f, good to soft) on second start over hurdles; she was much further behind Edith Pelham at Southwell 19 days ago, but these are early days for this handicap debutante.

runners.comment: Not the most persuasive evidence but this handicap debut should give her a better chance
runners.name: Gaelic Saint
runners.owner: Hot To Trot Jumping And Dahlbury
runners.spotlight: About 11l fourth to Betty's Daisy at Ludlow (2m5f, good to soft) on second start over hurdles; a bit better when coming from the rear for sixth of 12 at Market Rasen (near 2m5f, soft) on latest, which isn't the most persuasive evidence but this handicap debut should give her a better chance.

runners.comment: Backward steps on last two starts leave her with plenty to prove; handicap debut
runners.name: Future Bucks
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 5yo who won British debut at Windsor (2m, good to soft) in November; backward steps at Uttoxeter (2m6f, heavy) and Carlisle (extended 2m3f, good to soft) leave her with more to prove than plenty of these, although it is her handicap debut.

runners.comment: Dual bumper winner; second on latest start was at least her best show in this sphere
runners.name: Queenofthejukebox
runners.spotlight: Won two bumpers last term on good to soft; she's failed to match that form over hurdles but second of six on handicap debut at Wetherby (extended 2m3f, soft) last time was at least her best show in this sphere.

runners.comment: Won at Carlisle (extended 2m3f); has big swing in the weights with Indannya from Wincanton
runners.name: Sevarana
runners.spotlight: Won at Carlisle (extended 2m3f, good to soft) in February on second start over hurdles; 13l third to Indannya at Wincanton (1m7f) was better on RPRs and there's a big swing in the weights for today's handicap debut.

runners.comment: Lacks any solid claims for this handicap debut; tongue tied first time
runners.name: Ballynorth
runners.spotlight: Has shown a bit of ability in her three points and the two completions over hurdles, but those 18l and 19l defeats in this sphere don't present any solid claims for today's handicap debut; tongue tied first time.

15:35.race_name: Goffs Hundred Grand Bumper (An Open National Hunt Flat Race) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: 2-2 last summer but concedes weight all round and has plenty to find on the figures
runners.name: Way Maker
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten at Bangor (good) and Stratford (good to firm) last summer; may still be unexposed but he concedes weight all round and has plenty to find on the figures after seven months off.

runners.comment: Ready 10l winner on debut at Doncaster; open to improvement and high on the list
runners.name: Diamond Street
runners.spotlight: Out of a mare who won a bumper, and he made a really encouraging debut when readily accounting for six rivals at Doncaster (soft; 5-2 favourite; by 10l) in January; open to improvement and high on the list for a trainer-jockey combination that won this race 12 months ago.

runners.comment: 15l winner at Chepstow on second start, making all; should put up another bold show
runners.name: Keltype
runners.spotlight: Built significantly on debut form when winning at Chepstow (soft; 13-2) in January by 15l, always in front and surging clear from over 1f out; today's conditions are likely to be less testing but he should still put up another bold show.

runners.breeder: E A R L Guittet Desbois
runners.comment: Just shaken up to win at Kempton; major player for trainer with fine record in this sphere
runners.name: Lover Desbois
runners.spotlight: Showed promise on debut over C&D and duly progressed to beat 13 opponents at Kempton (good to soft) last month, travelling well and just shaken up to assert; major player for a trainer with a fine record in this sphere.

runners.comment: Blotted copybook with wayward display over C&D last time and needs to get back on track
runners.name: No Way Jay
runners.spotlight: Debut winner at Wincanton (good) but blotted his copybook with a wayward display in C&D Listed event (heavy; 17-2) six weeks ago and needs to get back on track.

runners.comment: Pulled up in point; interesting that connections throw him in at deep end for rules debut
runners.name: Saint Arion
runners.spotlight: £26,000 3yo; by Order Of St George; dam bumper winner; pulled up on his only go in points but interesting that connections throw him in at the deep end for rules debut; worth monitoring in the market.

runners.breeder: A McGladdery Ka Bloodstock & S Kemble
runners.comment: Fits the bill on pedigree but made no impact on debut at Kempton; improvement required
runners.name: Spanish Stroll
runners.spotlight: Fits the bill on pedigree (by Walk In The Park out of a bumper/2m hurdle winner) but he made no impact on debut at Kempton (good to soft; 22-1) four weeks ago; needs to have learned a lot in a short space of time.

runners.comment: Good fifth in Cheltenham Listed event; doesn't have much to find and may progress further
runners.name: The Mad Poet
runners.spotlight: Much better effort so far when fifth in Listed event at Cheltenham (soft) in November, fading after racing freely; looks the stable's second string on jockey bookings but he doesn't have much to find on form and may progress further.

runners.comment: Followed last-gasp Wincanton win with fine third at Cheltenham; has to be considered
runners.name: Baillys Comet
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to the high-class jumper Romeo Coolio; got up late on to make winning debut at Wincanton in November and improved markedly when third in Listed race at Cheltenham (good ground) on New Year's Day; yard does well in bumpers and won this race in 2023; has to be considered.

runners.comment: Debut winner at Carlisle; more needed to hold his own against much stronger opposition
runners.name: Irish Goodbye
runners.spotlight: Dug deep to make winning start at Carlisle (good to soft; 4-1) in February; however, that form doesn't look anything special and he'll need to progress to hold his own against today's much stronger opposition.

runners.comment: Good late work when fourth at Warwick; progress needed but that's not out of the question
runners.name: Callisto Queen
runners.spotlight: Nicely bred daughter of Telescope; did her best work late on when 10l fourth of 13 at Warwick (good to soft; 11-2) four months ago; improvement required to trouble some of these but that's not out of the question.

runners.comment: Met trouble in bunch finish at Ascot; no surprise if she improves fair bit with more luck
runners.name: Harzandacassandra
runners.owner: DL Adams JA Adams & G McPherson
runners.spotlight: Only seventh of nine on debut at Ascot (good to soft; 6-1) last month, but she wasn't beaten far in bunch finish after meeting trouble in steadily run race; no surprise if she improves a fair bit with more luck.

runners.comment: Useful pedigree; yard won last week's Fred Winter at Cheltenham with rare British runner
runners.name: Sheactslikesummer
runners.spotlight: £15,000 3yo; by Getaway out of a bumper and useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner; that's a plausible pedigree for a race like this, and her stable's only previous runner in Britain this season (Saratoga in last week's Fred Winter) was successful; well worth a market check.

runners.comment: By Jack Hobbs; trainer is a force to be reckoned with (3-10 last five seasons) in bumpers
runners.name: Always Proud
runners.spotlight: £19,000 3yo; Jack Hobbs half-brother to winners Marie De Medicis (French 1m), Wor Willie (1m4f/1m6f) and Dolly McQueen (1m3f); dam 1m4f winner; trainer has few runners these days but remains a force to be reckoned with (3-10 in last five seasons) in bumpers.

runners.comment: £54,000 3yo; needs keeping an eye on in the market with Alan King running two
runners.name: Master Roque
runners.spotlight: £54,000 3yo; brother to French 2m1f/2m3f hurdle winner Iban Roque; dam French 1m4f AQPS Flat and 2m3f/2m4f hurdle winner; needs watching in the market with Alan King (16% in bumpers in recent years) running two.

runners.comment: Yard has hit the target six times in bumpers with limited ammunition; interesting on paper
runners.name: Mistral Du Chenet
runners.spotlight: E37,000 2yo; No Risk At All half-brother to French 2m hurdle winner Lady Du Chenet; dam maiden jumper, half-sister to useful French 2m1f/2m2f hurdle winner Hotesse Du Chenet; yard has hit the target in bumpers of late with limited ammunition (6-30 in last five seasons); interesting on paper.

runners.comment: Newcomer; stable has well-above-average strike-rate in bumpers; can't be discounted
runners.name: Show Your Hand
runners.spotlight: £20,000 3yo; by Passing Glance; brother to bumper/2m3f hurdle winner Glancing Jack; dam 2m-2m4f hurdle winner; stable has maintained a well-above-average strike-rate in bumpers (33%) this season; can't be discounted.

runners.comment: £45,000 3yo; dam useful 1m7f-2m1f hurdle winner; another plausible newcomer
runners.name: Bella Decree
runners.spotlight: £45,000 3yo; by Order Of St George; dam useful 1m7f-2m1f hurdle winner; would have to be useful to make a winning start in a race with plenty of depth, but she's in good hands and it's not impossible.

runners.comment: Bred to be useful; Flat yard does well in bumpers; might be the pick of the newcomers
runners.name: Lady Hope
runners.spotlight: £55,000 3yo; Nathaniel half-sister to 2m4f hurdle winner Blue Run; dam 2m4f hurdle winner, half-sister to useful bumper and 3m/3m1f hurdle winner Lord Generous, out of top-class hurdler Lady Rebecca; bred to be useful and mainly Flat stable has had plenty of bumper winners over the years; could be the pick of the newcomers.

runners.comment: Shaped well when second at Wincanton; gets weight from most; big player for in-form yard
runners.name: Madam Speaker
runners.spotlight: Couldn't justify favouritism but still shaped well when second of 14 at Wincanton (good to soft) last month, no extra late on; likely to improve and gets weight from most of her rivals; leading player for in-form yard.

16:10.race_name: John Haine Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Poor run last time but nothing wrong with previous efforts this season; may bounce back
runners.name: Escapeandevade
runners.spotlight: Ran no sort of race at Sandown seven weeks ago but his previous four efforts had all been highly creditable, including a Haydock win (2m, soft; handles good) just before Christmas; no surprise if he bounces back for a yard in form.

runners.breeder: S C P Haras Des Coudraies
runners.comment: Close second over C&D latest; chance on that form but could do with jumping more fluently
runners.name: Kotmask
runners.spotlight: Almost as good as ever this season and he kept on well when 1l second of four over C&D (good to soft) three weeks ago; a repeat of that form would see him go close, with a tongue-strap added for the first time in Britain, but a losing sequence is developing and he tends to make mistakes.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De La Croix Sonnet Et Al
runners.comment: Unseated rider early last time; clearcut reappearance success gives him a chance
runners.name: Palacio
runners.spotlight: Unseated rider at halfway on this course last month; in and out overall but he would have a chance on his clearcut reappearance success over this distance at Chepstow and drying ground would not inconvenience him.

runners.comment: Won first two races over fences but the wheels came off here last time; rebound required
runners.name: Koukeo
runners.spotlight: Made encouraging start over fences with convincing victory at Windsor (2m, good) on New Year's Day, and he followed up at Haydock (2m, good to soft) two weeks later; however, the wheels came off when he went up in grade for the Greatwood here three weeks ago, and he was beaten before stamina became a factor; 5lb higher than for his second win and needs to get back on track.

runners.comment: Grand servant; had an excuse when pulled up last time and should be thereabouts
runners.name: Xcitations
runners.owner: G LibsonD BaylissT Davies & P Sly
runners.spotlight: Grand servant for the yard with eight wins (six over fences) and he showed he was no back number when second of four at Leicester (2m, soft; handles good) in February; took the wrong course last time; has form here and should be thereabouts.

16:45.race_name: Win Unique Experiences At OLBG Prizes Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Not at his best in 2025 but he's back to his last winning mark and has possibilities
runners.name: King Turgeon
runners.spotlight: Won good-quality handicaps at Aintree (2m5f) and Cheltenham (3m2f) towards end of 2024; not at best in 2025 but he shaped as if retaining ability; missed the Grimthorpe at Doncaster in February due to soft ground; drying conditions should help and, back to his last winning mark, he's a possible.

runners.comment: Well held in two races in the autumn; bit to prove after four months off
runners.name: Manothepeople
runners.spotlight: Veteran; last two wins came in the same 3m2f Cheltenham race in April 2024 and 2025; ran a lacklustre race there in October before possibly failing to stay 3m5f at Ascot; bit to prove after four months off.

runners.comment: Well held since lengthy break but mark has fallen and he's 2-2 over C&D; quite interesting
runners.name: Makinyourmindup
runners.spotlight: Has raced only twice since a lengthy layoff, looking rusty on return and seeming not to stay a testing 3m5f at Lingfield two months ago; has to prove he retains all of his ability but his mark is falling, he's still only nine and both his chase successes have come over C&D; quite interesting with Cobden on for the first time this season.

runners.comment: Followed Ludlow win with listless effort there; needs headgear to inject some sparkle
runners.name: Ballycamus
runners.spotlight: Rather in and out, and followed a Ludlow win (3m, good to soft) in December with a listless fourth over the same C&D three weeks ago; needs first-time headgear to inject some sparkle.

runners.comment: Not the force of old; poor run in veterans' chase at Doncaster latest; others appeal more
runners.name: Almazhar Garde
runners.spotlight: Not the force of old and his second at Catterick (3m1f, good) in November came in a two-horse race; followed that with a poor run in a veterans' chase at Doncaster; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Younger than most of these and could be unexposed; worth considering in new headgear
runners.name: Elysian Knight
runners.spotlight: Younger than most of these and posted a career best when second at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft) in February; stiffer task in C&D non-handicap next time; unexposed over this trip and beyond, and drying ground may suit (last win came on good); definitely of interest in first-time headgear.

runners.comment: Made all at Doncaster just after Christmas and had an excuse next time; could rebound
runners.name: Some Scope
runners.spotlight: Not easy to predict but he's only 2lb higher than when making all at Doncaster (3m, good) just after Christmas, and he probably went off too fast when beaten 33l there (3m2f, soft) three weeks ago; not discounted.

runners.comment: Fine third at Windsor on return but disappointing over C&D next time; needs to bounce back
runners.name: Havaila
runners.spotlight: Fine return to action when close third over 3m4f at Windsor (soft; handles good) in January, but he was a bit disappointing over this C&D next time and needs to bounce back.

13:00.race_name: BetWright Beeswing Mares' Hurdle (Listed Race) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Grade 2/Listed winner over hurdles; leading claims if seeing out this new trip
runners.name: Hollygrove Cha Cha
runners.spotlight: Won Grade 2 novice hurdle at Sandown (2m4f, soft) last February and scored at Exeter (2m1f, heavy) in December on second chase start; reverted to hurdles with all-the-way Listed win at Warwick (2m5f, heavy) last month; also effective on good/good to soft; half-sister to a 2m7f winner and there's every chance she'll stay this far; leading claims if seeing it out.

runners.comment: Won 2m4f handicap at Windsor two runs ago; needs to settle at new trip, but not ruled out
runners.name: Listentoyourheart
runners.owner: S T Racing - The Founders Syndicate
runners.spotlight: Game when winning 2m4f handicap at Windsor (good) on New Year's Day, shaping as though she would be worth a crack at a staying trip; soundly beaten at Ascot (2m3f, good to soft) since, and in view of this longer distance it's a concern she failed to settle that day, but she's not ruled out.

runners.comment: Two-time Listed winner who was Grade 3 runner-up last time; firmly in calculations
runners.name: World Of Fortunes
runners.spotlight: Two Listed novice hurdle wins last season (2m5f/3m, good/good to soft), one of them at Doncaster, and close second in Grade 3 at Punchestown (2m4f, soft) last month; this Irish challenger is firmly in calculations.

runners.comment: Has made a good start for her new yard but has plenty to find in today's company
runners.name: Pitwood Road
runners.spotlight: Won handicap at Carlisle (2m3f, soft) in December on stable debut and went close at Newcastle (2m4f, heavy) in January; could continue to progress for this yard but has plenty to find in today's company.

runners.comment: Two wins in autumn but progress has stalled since; going right-handed would be preferable
runners.name: Rockola Vogue
runners.spotlight: Kicked off current campaign with two handicap wins in a row in the autumn (2m3f/2m7f, good); her progress has stalled at Doncaster (3m, good/soft) on her last two starts and, while she may still have more to offer when returning to a right-handed track, she's once more going left-handed today.

runners.comment: Three-time course winner; drying conditions are a positive but she looks out of her depth
runners.name: Starlyte
runners.spotlight: Three-time course winner for whom the drying conditions are a positive but she looks out of her depth this afternoon.

runners.comment: Needs another step forward but things appear to have clicked for this lightly raced 7yo
runners.name: Star Walking
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with good second to Rockola Vogue in Ascot handicap (2m7f, good) in November then went one better at Kempton (3m, good) in December; she needs another step forward now up in grade but things appear to have clicked for this lightly raced 7yo and she could be a contender.

runners.comment: Has run well in Listed/Grade 2 races this season and today's new trip may be within range
runners.name: Sunset Marquesa
runners.spotlight: Won 2m4f handicap at Sandown (soft) in December and she ran well in defeat in Listed/Grade 2 races on next two starts (2m4f/1m7f, good/soft); mid-race unseat at Cheltenham last week; she's a half-sister to a 3m2f winner and it's possible this new trip will be within range; in with a chance.

runners.comment: She's won handicap on last four hurdle starts; remains to be seen where limitations lie
runners.name: Tankardstown Diva
runners.spotlight: Highly progressive for new yard this season and has won handicaps on her last four hurdle starts (2m7f-3m1f, good-soft), most recently in comfortable fashion at Ludlow last month; this is a much tougher test of her credentials but it remains to be seen where her limitations now lie.

13:30.race_name: BetWright Handicap Hurdle (Go North Cab On Target Series Final) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Made it 2-2 in handicaps when winning here last month; progressive and holds solid claims
runners.name: Judicial Deference
runners.spotlight: Won maiden hurdle at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft) in December on second rules start and 2-2 in handicaps since (2m5f/2m6f, good to soft/heavy), the latest here last month; progressive and holds solid claims.

runners.comment: Flopped at Ayr recently but won three times last month; might be dangerous to dismiss
runners.name: Thank You Blue
runners.spotlight: Flopped at Ayr (2m4f, soft) a fortnight ago; however, this 9yo was in career-best form last month, winning three in a row (2m4f/2m, good to soft/soft), and it might be dangerous to dismiss his claims.

runners.comment: Two wins last year; respectable runs since; lightly raced and may still have more to offer
runners.name: Baratablet
runners.spotlight: Won at Perth (2m4f, good to soft) last April and followed up at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) in December; he's performed respectably here (2m6f, good to soft) and at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) since and this lightly raced 6yo may still have more to offer, especially now back up in trip.

runners.comment: Not beaten far back over hurdles in January and the step back up in trip could be a plus
runners.name: Captain Butler
runners.spotlight: Course maiden hurdle winner who was a promising second on handicap debut at Ayr (2m4f, soft) in November; not beaten far in fifth when back over hurdles at Haydock (1m7f, good to soft) in January and the step back up in trip could be a positive move; possible player.

runners.comment: Won at Sedgefield on first crack at 2m4f but tailed off at Catterick since
runners.name: Kingston Narcissus
runners.spotlight: Enhanced his good record at Sedgefield when winning there in a first-time tongue-tie on Boxing Day on his first crack at 2m4f (good to soft); however, tailed off at Catterick since on soft ground he should have handled, and he needs to bounce back with a visor now added.

runners.comment: Won three times in the winter and bled from the nose when well beaten at Catterick latest
runners.name: Bathgate
runners.spotlight: Yet to run well at Kelso (three attempts) and well beaten at Catterick last time; however, he had an excuse (bled from the nose) and he won three times in the winter (2m1f/2m3f, soft/good to soft); not written off.

runners.comment: Has done well in cheekpieces, winning her last two; this thriving mare is respected
runners.name: Speiriuil
runners.spotlight: With a new yard this season and has been better than ever since these cheekpieces went on, winning here (2m2f, good to soft) in December and following up at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft); this thriving mare is respected.

runners.breeder: S C E A Haras Du Puy
runners.comment: In good form in cheekpieces of late and this three-time course winner might be thereabouts
runners.name: Eloi Du Puy
runners.spotlight: These cheekpieces and a switch to prominent tactics have prompted good performances at Ayr (2m4f, soft) on his last two starts, finishing second then first; he's won three times here in the past (including on good to soft) and might be thereabouts.

runners.comment: Off a reduced mark he was third to Eloi Du Puy at Ayr and he might not be far away
runners.name: Jericoacoara
runners.owner: G R Orchard & Mrs J M Gray
runners.spotlight: His French win came in 2023 and he's 0-6 in Britain, but he's dropped down the weights and ran well when third to Eloi Du Puy at Ayr (2m4f, soft) last month; has also shown promise on good to soft; might not be far away.

runners.comment: Back to form with close, clear second at Ayr and he can be in the mix if backing that up
runners.name: Coconut Splash
runners.spotlight: 11yo who has a poor strike-rate and isn't the force of old but, following a wind op, he returned to form with a clear, close second in a first-time visor (retained) at Ayr (2m4f, soft) a fortnight ago; also effective on good to soft; in the mix if backing up that latest run, despite 6lb rise.

runners.breeder: His Highness The Aga Khans Studs S C
runners.comment: He's tumbled down weights since British debut; not shaping as though about to capitalise
runners.name: Rauzan
runners.spotlight: Won four in a row over hurdles in Ireland in May-July 2024; he's tumbled down the weights since his British debut in November 2025 but hasn't been shaping as though he's about to take advantage.

runners.comment: A win and a good third from his two handicaps; in excellent hands to continue to progress
runners.name: Brookside La
runners.spotlight: Won on handicap debut at Wetherby (2m3f, soft) on Boxing Day before 4l third of 17 to Judicial Deference at Haydock (2m5f, good to soft) in January; he's 9lb better off with his old rival, who has won again since, and is in excellent hands to continue to progress; strong candidate.

runners.comment: Pulled up at Ayr last time but on soft; two wins over C&D on good ground in the autumn
runners.name: The Navigator
runners.spotlight: 11yo who was tailed off over C&D (good to soft) in November and pulled up at 100-1 at Ayr (2m4f, soft) last month on his sole start since; however, the drying conditions are a positive, with his last five wins coming on good ground, and he won two in a row over C&D last autumn to take his winning tally at Kelso to four; no surprise if he bounces back with a bold show.

runners.comment: Of interest on her autumn form but not quite at the same level in the winter
runners.name: Mountain Molly
runners.spotlight: Won novice hurdle at Perth (2m4f, good) last September and good second off this mark there (2m4f, soft) next time; however, she wasn't quite at the same level in the winter and needs something extra now in cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Encouraging fourth on handicap debut at Ayr and every chance he'll continue to progress
runners.name: Rock Dj
runners.owner: Ursa Major Ltd Dj Goodman & Partner
runners.spotlight: Good-ground point runner-up who has improved with each of his four runs under rules and was an encouraging fourth on handicap debut at Ayr (2m4f, soft) in January; there's every chance he'll continue to progress; chance.

runners.comment: Held at Haydock in January but in good form over hurdles previously; AW win last week
runners.name: Wasthatok
runners.spotlight: Won easily at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) in November and runner-up to progressive winner at Catterick (2m3f, good) in December; soundly beaten behind Judicial Deference at Haydock (2m5f, good to soft) in January but he's probably better than that and he won on the AW last week; not ruled out.

14:10.race_name: BetWright Herring Queen Series Final Mares' Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: Elevage Du Colombier Haras De Saint-Voi
runners.comment: 2-time novice hurdle winner who is in top hands and could be better than her opening mark
runners.name: Khrisma
runners.spotlight: Won two Grade 3 bumpers in France and she made it 2-5 in novice hurdles when scoring cosily at Market Rasen (2m, soft) last month; also effective on good ground; in top hands and could be better than her opening mark.

runners.comment: Two wins from first three starts for this yard and perhaps her latest run came too soon
runners.name: Queenie St Clair
runners.spotlight: Two wins (1m7f/2m, good to soft/heavy) from her first three starts for this yard and perhaps her latest run at Newbury three weeks ago came too soon, just six days after she won at Fontwell; not discounted.

runners.comment: Won at Taunton last month and could continue to progress now switched to handicaps
runners.name: Beauty In The Park
runners.spotlight: Went close at Taunton (2m, good to soft) in January on second hurdle start and improved again to win there (2m, heavy) last month; could continue to progress now switched to handicaps and she's one to consider.

runners.comment: Respectable fifth in Grade 2 novice last month and not ruled out in her first handicap
runners.name: Anariza
runners.spotlight: One win from her six hurdle starts, which came at Wetherby (2m, soft) in November; performed respectably in fifth in Grade 2 novice at Kempton (2m, good to soft) last month and she's not ruled out in her first handicap.

runners.comment: Clear second on h'cap debut at Ludlow; could play another leading role even now 4lb higher
runners.name: Diamonds Galore
runners.owner: Turf Club 2024 & The Burling Family Ltd
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two novice hurdles towards end of last year (2m/2m5f, good/good to soft) and filled the same position when beaten half a length on last month's handicap debut at Ludlow (2m, soft); she was well clear of the third last time and could play another leading role even now 4lb higher.

runners.comment: Runner-up on h'cap hurdle debut at Carlisle; could still be capable of better in this code
runners.name: Azahara Palace
runners.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner (including on good ground) who won at Hexham (2m, heavy) in December on second hurdle start; 6l second of 14 behind improving winner on handicap hurdle debut at Carlisle (2m1f, soft) last month and could still be capable of better in this code in view of her Flat form.

runners.comment: Close second at Ludlow last month and on that evidence there's mileage in her opening mark
runners.name: First Candidate
runners.spotlight: Point winner who has improved with each of her three hurdle runs, going close at Ludlow (2m, soft) last month; the winner has followed up in a handicap, suggesting there should be mileage in this mare's opening mark.

runners.comment: Would have given 1-10 favourite even more of a scare had she not swerved over C&D latest
runners.name: Changemyluck
runners.spotlight: Improved upon previous form when close, clear second in C&D novice (good to soft) three weeks ago, and she would have given the 1-10 favourite even more of a scare had she not swerved left approaching the final flight; no surprise to see another good performance on this handicap debut.

runners.comment: Runner-up to Beauty In The Park at Taunton and she's 6lb better off on this handicap debut
runners.name: Yeld To Call
runners.spotlight: Fourth in warm novice hurdle against males at Newbury (2m, good to soft) in January and runner-up to Beauty In The Park at Taunton (2m, heavy) next time, beaten just over 3l; she's 6lb better off with the winner on this handicap debut and could have a part to play in a first-time tongue-tie.

runners.comment: Likeable performance when clear second at Wincanton; could be in the mix on handicap debut
runners.name: Our Peggy
runners.spotlight: Point winner who has improved with each of her three hurdle runs, finishing clear of the rest when second at Wincanton (1m7f, good to soft) recently; that was a likeable effort and she could be in the mix on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Could benefit from the drop back in trip but others arrive with more compelling claims
runners.name: Belle Le Grand
runners.spotlight: Won two novice hurdles last May (2m/2m1f) and she could benefit from this drop back in trip; however, she hasn't shone in handicaps this winter and others are more compelling, including stablemate First Candidate.

runners.comment: 5l second of four on h'cap debut; it looked a warm little contest; may have more to offer
runners.name: Klassy Pearl
runners.spotlight: Two-time point runner-up (including on good to yielding) who has finished second on her last two starts, most recently on handicap debut at Exeter (2m, heavy); she was beaten 5l in that four-runner race last time but it looked a warm little contest and she may have more to offer.

runners.comment: Easy win in recent Catterick maiden and she could be progressive; not discounted
runners.name: Riviera Walk
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner (good to soft) who had been headed but was disputing second when falling two out at Wincanton (2m4f, soft) in December on her sole handicap start; she's since easily won a maiden at Catterick (1m7f, good) and she could be progressive; not discounted.

runners.comment: Her maiden hurdle win didn't reveal much and she was down the field on handicap debut
runners.name: Gintime
runners.spotlight: Capitalised on the two market leaders exiting the race three out in four-runner maiden hurdle at Sedgefield (2m1f, good to soft) on Boxing Day; she's unexposed and in good hands but finished down the field on last month's handicap debut at Carlisle (2m1f, good to soft); improvement needed.

runners.breeder: Mill House Stud & Mr N Farrell
runners.comment: Makes handicap debut off workable mark after wind op; represents in-form southern stable
runners.name: Crystal Days
runners.owner: Mrs S Lee And E Lee
runners.spotlight: Good-ground bumper winner who has run well in defeat on two of her three hurdle starts, most recently runner-up at Catterick (1m7f, good) in December; has had wind op since; makes handicap debut off workable mark and she's the sole runner here today for her in-form southern trainer; interesting.

runners.comment: Runner-up on first two hurdle starts before Hereford blip; she's not ruled out each-way
runners.name: Madame La Papillon
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who was runner-up on her first two hurdle starts (2m/2m1f, soft/good to soft); disappointing favourite at Hereford (2m, soft) since but she failed to settle and was hampered a couple of times; retains potential and she's not ruled out each-way on handicap debut.

14:40.race_name: BetWright Novices' Handicap Chase (Go North Forgive 'N Forget Series Final) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Short-headed at Wetherby last month and this unexposed 7yo is a major player
runners.name: Diamond Dealer
runners.spotlight: Won in the autumn on first two chase starts (2m7f, good/good to soft; including here) then failed to stay 4m here in the Borders National; bounced back with short-head defeat at Wetherby (3m, soft) last month and there can be optimism he'll be fine at this shorter distance; major player.

runners.comment: Won at Uttoxeter in January; disappointing since but this 5yo isn't written off
runners.name: My Noble Lord
runners.spotlight: Won at Uttoxeter (2m4f, soft) in January when wearing first-time cheekpieces (retained) on his third chase start; disappointing since but this 5yo isn't written off today; won on good to soft ground on the Flat.

runners.comment: Course hurdle winner who was a good second over fences at Sandown recently; contender
runners.name: Glen Road
runners.spotlight: Completed hurdle double when winning here (2m6f, soft) in December and tapped back into that promise when runner-up at Sandown (2m4f, soft) a fortnight ago on his third run over fences; won on good to soft going over hurdles; that latest form reads well and he's high on the list this afternoon.

runners.comment: Placed twice in a row in December and has had possible excuses on his last two starts
runners.name: Joecooker
runners.spotlight: Placed twice in a row in December (2m4f/2m3f, soft/good to soft) and had an excuse (hampered) at Newcastle in January; heavy ground may have been against him here last time and he's not discounted now in cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Won at Newcastle in January and heavy ground may not have suited here next time
runners.name: Moon Phases
runners.spotlight: Won at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) in January on second chase start and heavy ground may not have suited here last month when a well-beaten third; this very lightly raced 7yo retains potential and could go well.

runners.comment: Twice made all in the autumn but progress has stalled on his last two outings
runners.name: Sleeping Satellite
runners.spotlight: Twice made all in the autumn (2m3f, good) but his progress has stalled on his last two outings and he needs something extra if he's to return to winning ways today.

runners.breeder: Mrs Mossie Hayes & Mr Tom Hayes
runners.comment: Hit with 8lb rise for Musselburgh but had plenty in hand and could still be well treated
runners.name: Bridge Court
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Catterick in December on first two chase starts (2m3f, good to soft/good) and bounced back from lesser show at Haydock to win at Musselburgh (2m7f, soft) last month; hit with 8lb rise for last time but he had plenty in hand and could still be well treated.

runners.comment: Won first two chase starts; Newcastle defeat doesn't necessarily mean mark is beyond him
runners.name: Always A Reason
runners.owner: Miss Maria D Myco & John Johnson
runners.spotlight: Won in January on first two chase starts (2m4f/2m3f, good to soft/soft), shaping each time as though he had more left in the tank; soundly beaten at Newcastle (2m, good to soft) since but that maybe shouldn't be taken as a sign that his current mark is beyond him; cheekpieces go on.

runners.comment: Well beaten last time when bidding for a four-timer; stamina to prove over new trip
runners.name: Stick With Me Sam
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs Jw Dale & & Mrs Jdj Copas
runners.spotlight: Won three times in a row this winter (1m7f/2m, heavy-good to soft); made mistakes when well beaten at Newcastle (2m, good to soft) last time and his yard is in good form, but he needs to prove he can cope with his current mark, and also today's step up in trip.

runners.comment: Progressive in cheekpieces and now gets blinkers; a career best is necessary up in grade
runners.name: Defence Witness
runners.spotlight: Progressive in cheekpieces this season, winning twice (2m5f/3m1f, good to soft/soft) and posting a good second at Sedgefield (3m2f, soft) last time; it's possible the first-time blinkers will prompt a positive reaction today but he's up in grade and a career best is necessary.

15:13.race_name: Remembering Duncan Davidson Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Goes well here but he's on a tough mark and has become very all or nothing
runners.name: Cadell
runners.spotlight: Won this last year and scored again here in November when in first-time blinkers (good to soft); however, he's on a tough mark and has become all or nothing; races prominently.

runners.comment: Mostly progressive chaser and feasible excuses when beaten 23l in the Eider
runners.name: Fortunate Man
runners.spotlight: Did well last season; kicked off this campaign with a 3l win at Aintree (3m1f, good to soft) on Boxing Day and didn't run badly in valuable races on next two outings, last time in the Eider after which he was treated for post-race heat stress; he was joint-favourite for that and this race isn't as demanding.

runners.comment: Back to form when second over 2m4f last time and now returns to a better trip
runners.name: Dare To Shout
runners.spotlight: Last win was off a higher mark and he'll appreciate returning to further after chasing home a good thing over 2m4f at Ayr (soft; fine on good ground); that was a welcome return to form; definite chance if he can back it up.

runners.comment: 2-5 over fences; still on a fair mark and open to further progress, he's a player
runners.name: Aboutdamntime
runners.spotlight: Has won two of his five chases and reportedly appreciated the drier surface (good to soft) when prevailing narrowly over 3m at Ludlow last time; off only 3lb higher and open to further progress, he's seriously considered.

runners.comment: Competitive mark but has to bounce back from a pretty poor run at Bangor
runners.name: Breeze Of Wind
runners.spotlight: Strong stayer who was 6lb out of the weights when runner-up in the Scottish Borders National here in December; off the same mark for this but has to bounce back from a pretty poor run at Bangor; cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: Recent Ayr winner; 4lb wrong so he's 9lb higher this time and in a stronger race to boot
runners.name: Blakey Boy
runners.spotlight: Has made steady progress in the cheekpieces and would have won anyway last time at Ayr after being left clear late on (3m, soft); 4lb out of the weights so he's 9lb higher this time and in a stronger race to boot.

runners.comment: Solid record includes a C&D win; beat all bar the market leader at Newcastle last time
runners.name: Eagles Reprieve
runners.spotlight: Solid record comprises two wins, including over C&D on penultimate start, and four second-place finishes; beat all bar the market leader at Newcastle (2m4f) most recently; major contender.

runners.comment: Drops back in class after Grade 2 attempt; won easily at Newcastle on penultimate start
runners.name: Gaelic Rover
runners.spotlight: Towards the rear when clipping heels and falling in Grade 2 at Kelso (2m2f) most recently; won easily at Newcastle (2m1f) the time before and enters calculations back down in class; dam stayed 3m1f.

runners.breeder: Mrs Sandra Cozenot & Mr Herve Cozenot
runners.comment: Two from two, namely point/hurdle wins; promising southern raider who commands respect
runners.name: Le Frimeur
runners.spotlight: Two from two, namely wins in Irish point and Chepstow maiden hurdle (2m3f) last year; promising southern raider who commands respect; declared 2:00 Newbury Friday.

runners.comment: Has plenty to find
runners.name: Ivans Legacy
runners.spotlight: Consistent in bumpers, albeit with ordinary RPRs; couple of poorer results at Kelso since switched to hurdles; plenty to find.

runners.comment: Poor claims on form
runners.name: Melbourne Ghost
runners.spotlight: Twice-raced 5yo who has poor claims on form; upped in trip.

runners.comment: Just an ordinary maiden and faces a stiffer task on these terms
runners.name: Rememberthename
runners.spotlight: Placed several times, including off a mark of 101 in Musselburgh handicap (2m4f) most recently; just an ordinary maiden and faces a stiffer task on these terms.

runners.comment: Beaten long way on the switch to rules
runners.name: Talk To The Boss
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in Irish point but beaten long way at Newcastle on the switch to rules; may be one for handicaps later on.

runners.comment: Maiden; consistent until disappointing in last two starts, latest yesterday (favourite)
runners.name: The G Wizard
runners.spotlight: Maiden; consistent until disappointing in last two starts, latest at Musselburgh yesterday (favourite); ties in with Eagles Reprieve on C&D form in November but needs to rebound.

runners.comment: Modest fourth at Kelso last time; needs improvement
runners.name: Bollin Skittle
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced mare who may be suited by this new trip but has a lot to find on form; modest fourth at Kelso (2m) most recently.

16:23.race_name: Racing Post+ Jodami Open NH Flat Race (Category 2 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Point/bumper winner; unplaced last time but fitting of hood may help this free-going sort
runners.name: Kilaro
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt in points and followed up at Musselburgh on rules debut; only fifth (behind Diamond White) at Newcastle since but can't be written off; fitting of hood may suit this free-going sort.

runners.comment: Won his latest attempt in British points; sold for £60,000 since; check the betting
runners.name: Barito
runners.spotlight: Raced twice in British points, winning three-finisher event at Sheriff Hutton latest; subsequently sold for £60,000; difficult to assess firmly but has potential; market may offer further guidance.

runners.comment: Gives the impression he may benefit from this switch to forecast faster ground
runners.name: El Gangster
runners.spotlight: Failed to improve at Ayr kept to soft going but gives the impression he may benefit from this switch to forecast faster ground; half-brother to a bumper winner and progress remains possible.

runners.comment: Hung left but otherwise showed promise with third-place finish at Ayr; may progress
runners.name: King Kubala
runners.spotlight: Spoiled his finishing effort by hanging left, possibly through greenness, but otherwise showed promise with his third of nine at Ayr; half-brother to a winner for his stable and looks open to progress.

runners.comment: Placed over C&D last time; this switch to faster ground may prompt further progress
runners.name: Presentandcorrect
runners.spotlight: Has taken a good hold in both starts but took a step forward with placed effort over C&D (heavy) latest and gives the impression this switch to forecast better ground may prove ideal; possibilities.

runners.comment: Consistent thus far; third of 15 at Newcastle most recently; solid contender
runners.name: Diamond White
runners.spotlight: Consistent thus far, having finished second in Irish point and third in two bumpers, latest in 15-runner field at Newcastle; very solid contender as things stand and may still have progress in her.

runners.comment: Couple of fourth-place finishes at Ayr, beaten 49l latest; opposed
runners.name: Oor Wish
runners.spotlight: Couple of fourth-place finishes at Ayr, beaten 20l then 49l; the regress last time doesn't bode well and, on breeding, she's one for longer trips over jumps in due course.

runners.comment: Sole 4yo in this field and interesting at the weights, with another step forward possible
runners.name: Fridaysman
runners.owner: Mrs J Porter And P Kirby
runners.spotlight: Out of a dual winner in this sphere; raced twice in junior bumpers in the autumn, better effort when fourth at Aintree; sole 4yo in this field and interesting at the weights, with another step forward possible.

13:07.race_name: Alfa Aggregates Products Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Runner-up in his second Irish point but might be one for the long game
runners.name: Annual Invitation
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in his second Irish point (yielding to soft), finishing 10 clear of the third who hasn't looked up to much under rules; might be one for the long game.

runners.comment: Bumper form here offers hope; quiet hurdle debut but headgear returns
runners.name: Donald Jump
runners.spotlight: Third (bang there) and fourth in two good-ground bumpers here last summer; beat only one home in 2m Chepstow novice a month ago but the tongue-strap returns together with a new hood; should run better, but others are more convincing.

runners.comment: Irish point winner and runner-up to a good horse on hurdle debut at Carlisle; up in trip
runners.name: Double Indemnity
runners.spotlight: Bought for £30,000 after winning an Irish point; runner-up to a good horse on hurdle debut at Carlisle (2m1f, good to soft) and, having kept on that day, he's now raised in trip; each-way claims.

runners.comment: Insufficient promise in two bumpers and as many hurdle races to warrant a second look
runners.name: Gimarias
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Mr A Rutherford
runners.spotlight: Insufficient promise in two bumpers and as many hurdle races to warrant a second look on this occasion; however, last run offered hope with a view to handicaps later on.

runners.comment: Hasn't looked devoid of ability in bumpers or over hurdles but he'd be a surprise winner
runners.name: Good Boy Griff
runners.spotlight: Hasn't looked devoid of ability in bumpers or over hurdles but he'd be a surprise winner.

runners.breeder: Dr V Emmanuel Boutin Et Al
runners.comment: Bumper winner; quiet so far over hurdles and tongue-tie needs to make a difference
runners.name: Jorah dAlma
runners.spotlight: Won a Ludlow bumper on good to soft; tailed off and pulled up on soft ground over hurdles and the tongue-tie needs to make a difference.

runners.comment: Irish point winner; tailed off in a bumper and on hurdling debut
runners.name: McElhattan
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner; tailed off in a bumper and on hurdling debut, though the latest race was won by Albert Bartlett winner Johnny's Jury; best watched for the time being.

runners.comment: Clearcut winner of an Irish point and his Wincanton fourth was encouraging
runners.name: Mossy Fen Coolio
runners.spotlight: Hammered a subsequent winner in his Irish point (yielding); only 2-1 for hurdling debut at Wincanton (1m7f, heavy) and shaped quite well, finishing fourth of 17 and 13l behind the Fred Winter fourth Pourquoi Pas Papa; likely improver.

runners.comment: Clear of the rest last time over this trip at Hereford and this looks a good opportunity
runners.name: Tommy Pickles
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner on deep ground; placed in all his hurdles races from good to soft to heavy; clear of the rest last time over this trip at Hereford and this looks a good opportunity.

runners.comment: Two heavy defeats over hurdles, at 80-1 on both occasions; one for handicaps
runners.name: Drakaris
runners.spotlight: Questionable what she achieved in two small-field bumpers at Sedgefield and especially now after two heavy defeats over hurdles, at 80-1 on both occasions; one for handicaps.

runners.comment: Ended 2025 with career-best effort but looked laboured on first two outings this year
runners.name: Benign Dictator
runners.spotlight: Posted career-best effort when scoring at Warwick (3m2f, good to soft) in December but two laboured efforts have followed this year; wore refitted cheekpieces last time; first-time blinkers are given a whirl here.

runners.comment: Well beaten on both starts since returning from a long layoff in December
runners.name: Lord Snootie
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on both starts since returning from long layoff in December; will appreciate this ease in grade but his current ability remains tricky to gauge; considered only if strong in the betting.

runners.comment: Well beaten over fences last month but reverts to hurdling on a tempting mark; interesting
runners.name: Gentleman Bill
runners.spotlight: Dual 2m hurdle winner (once here) last season who showed considerable promise over fences towards end of last year; suffered a fall and a heavy defeat last month but now reverts to hurdling on a tempting mark; completely unexposed over this sort of trip under rules; interesting.

runners.comment: Now 1lb below last winning mark but has been out of form since the autumn
runners.name: Pinot Rouge
runners.spotlight: Now 1lb lower than when scoring at Hexham (2m7f, good to soft) last June but has been out of form over hurdles and fences since returning from a break in the autumn; blinkers the headgear of choice today; revival needed.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras Du Mondant
runners.comment: Flopped badly when warm favourite this month; moves up in trip with a point to prove
runners.name: French Emperor
runners.spotlight: Came good when switched to handicaps in the autumn, winning over 2m at Worcester (good) and Cheltenham (soft), but is yet to make any further progress; flopped badly when warm favourite at Exeter (2m) a fortnight ago and has a point to prove on this first venture beyond about 2m4f under rules.

runners.breeder: Sc Racing Investment Society Ecurie Ris
runners.comment: Two wins for Olly Murphy this season; ran poorly last month; now with new stable
runners.name: Gwennie May Star
runners.spotlight: Won twice over hurdles for Dan Skelton last season (2m1f/2m3f) and twice for Olly Murphy this term (3m1f); ran poorly on latest outing five weeks ago, though, and remains on career-high mark for this stable debut.

runners.breeder: E U R L Agb Agency & Mrs D Billebaut
runners.comment: Well held when second on handicap debut (2m4f) but can improve over this new trip
runners.name: Karma Police
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 6yo; no match for clear winner when second on handicap debut at Newbury (2m4f, good to soft) three weeks ago but that was still a good effort and he's open to improvement over this longer trip; respected.

runners.comment: Ex-Irish gelding who is 0-10 for this yard but he has the form to threaten all of these
runners.name: Joyeux Machin
runners.spotlight: Exposed ex-Irish gelding who has yet to score for Dan Skelton (0-10); however, he has been contesting stronger races and was going nicely in clear lead when falling six out in major handicap chase at Doncaster (3m, soft; fine on good) in January; his subsequent Ascot run needs forgiving but that was a Class 1 race.

runners.comment: Could be dangerous off this mark, for all that he's made his name over further
runners.name: Val Dancer
runners.spotlight: Last season was one to remember, winning the Welsh National and later second in the Grand National Trial at Haydock; 0-4 this campaign but it's been anything but a washout and he should be dangerous off this mark, for all that he's made his name over further.

runners.comment: Long absence to overcome and aged 11, but potentially very well handicapped
runners.name: Castle Robin
runners.spotlight: Strike-rate of 4-14 over fences but has seen very little action during the past three years and now returns from an even lengthier absence at the age of 11; potentially very well handicapped should market vibes bode well.

runners.comment: Bang in form, still on a fair mark and drying ground won't bother him at all
runners.name: No Tackle
runners.spotlight: Won in a refitted visor at Lingfield (2m6f) in November and runner-up on next three outings, which represents career-best form; still on a fair mark and drying ground won't bother him at all.

runners.comment: On a hat-trick but he's up in the weights and in grade, and may need soft ground
runners.name: Bo Cruz
runners.spotlight: Has soon left all his hurdle form behind over fences and arrives here on a hat-trick after clearcut wins in Class 5 soft-ground handicaps over similar trips at Catterick and Wetherby; the concerns are whether he can deal with the latest 10lb rise in classier company and drying ground might not be ideal.

runners.comment: Others appeal more, for all that getting back on drier ground will benefit
runners.name: Maggies Boy
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Cartmel (2m6f maiden; 11-4 joint-favourite) last May but not a lot since and others appeal more, for all that getting back on drier ground will benefit.

runners.comment: Low-mileage 6yo who ran his best race yet on handicap debut at Southwell (2m4f)
runners.name: Kastellion
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 6yo who ran his best race yet on handicap debut at Southwell (2m4f, soft) and he's given the impression that this could be more his trip; respected.

runners.comment: Hard to make a solid case but this well-related 6yo could yet turn a corner
runners.name: Greedy Smith
runners.spotlight: Hard to make a solid case but the ground was soft when pulled up on his handicap debut at Doncaster where he was upped to 3m from 2m; also has questions to answer on this drier ground but this well-related 6yo could yet turn a corner.

runners.comment: Refused over fences last time; a maiden over hurdles but has the form to feature
runners.name: Diamand De Vindecy
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden over hurdles but has placed form and he won six on the Flat; made a bright start over fences in January but didn't fancy it at Huntingdon and refused early; the cheekpieces are off but wouldn't be a surprise to see him run well.

runners.comment: Has only had seven races under rules and was a 3l winner last time at Ludlow
runners.name: An Buachaill Rua
runners.spotlight: A 3l winner at Ludlow (2m5f, good to soft) to get off the mark over hurdles and he'd performed to a similar level before; up 6lb but Harry Atkins claims 7lb (3lb claimer employed last time) and this 6yo has only had seven races under rules.

runners.comment: Better for handicaps when beaten 10l over 2m4f last time and he was boxing on
runners.name: Mooserwirt
runners.spotlight: He was always likely to fare better in handicaps and duly took a step forward when beaten 10l at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) four weeks ago; kept on that day, in keeping with his pedigree; likely contender in the new tongue-tie.

runners.comment: May be seen in a better light on this switch to handicaps and he's unraced beyond 2m4f
runners.name: Dublin City
runners.owner: Mrs J A Benson & Miss S N Benson
runners.spotlight: May be seen in a better light on this switch to handicaps and he's unraced beyond 2m4f (third in a 3m point), but wouldn't be the percentage play.

runners.breeder: E A R L Ecurie Des Mottes
runners.comment: Form figures confirm his current wellbeing but improvement has come on slow ground
runners.name: Junior Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: Won two of his first three for this trainer but turned over at odds-on the last twice; only 1l higher than when beaten 2l last week at Fontwell (2m5f) but his improvement has come on slow ground; blinkers replace cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Headgear is added for this first handicap; trainers are respected
runners.name: Thereyare
runners.owner: Rocket & Stan Coxon Hadfield And Stott
runners.spotlight: Has offered precious little in his qualifying races (2m-2m4f; 40-1 to 80-1) but he was second in an Irish point and headgear is added for this first handicap; trainers are respected (also run Mooserwirt), so needs a market check over this longer trip.

runners.comment: Plenty of risks involved after his long absence with a hood now fitted
runners.name: Rockvale
runners.spotlight: Failed to build on a mildly encouraging hurdle debut and his first handicap was over fences when tailed off at Ludlow (2m4f) in late 2024; plenty of risks involved after his long absence with a hood now fitted.

runners.comment: Modest chase efforts last twice; no worthwhile form in handicaps over hurdles
runners.name: Jo Arengeot Bey AA
runners.spotlight: No worthwhile form in his handicaps over hurdles and last two chase runs were also underwhelming.

15:20.race_name: Virgin Bet Supports Safe Gambling Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Definite chance on his penultimate run; however, not the only front-runner in the field
runners.name: Knickerbockerglory
runners.spotlight: Ran no race at Windsor in January; however, prior to that he went close in a Class 2 handicap at Sandown (2m, soft; effective on good to soft); on a handy mark if factoring in Harry Atkins' claim; front runner, and not the only one.

runners.comment: Won easily last time and has shown that he can cope with this 3lb higher mark
runners.name: Aurigny Mill
runners.spotlight: Goes well at Taunton where he won comfortably a month ago (2m, heavy; second run in cheekpieces), and has shown he can deal with this 3lb higher mark and this sort of ground; has won going left-handed and, with a strike-rate of 6-18 over hurdles, this 9yo is likable.

runners.comment: Won this last year before following up at Ayr and is well handicapped on all that
runners.name: The Four Sixes
runners.spotlight: Won this last year before following up at Ayr and is well handicapped on all that; however, this season's wins have been over fences and it's been a struggle back hurdling the last twice.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De La Croix Sonnet
runners.comment: Useful front-running chaser and could be interesting off his lower hurdle mark
runners.name: Magistrato
runners.spotlight: Ended last year in excellent form over fences, with latest fourth coming behind the seriously progressive Thistle Ask; whereas he's 5-18 in that discipline and only 1-13 over hurdles, he's probably a better horse now than when last seen in this discipline; 5lb lower than his chase mark; front runs.

runners.breeder: Mme Marie Merienne Mr Julien Merienne
runners.comment: A willing partner when winning at Haydock; up 5lb but not exposed over this far
runners.name: Static
runners.spotlight: It was a Class 4 he won at Haydock (good to soft; raced prominently) but that was his first time over this far since arriving from France and he's a willing partner; Charlie Maggs rides again off a 5lb higher mark.

runners.comment: Well handicapped; back from a break and hasn't had many chances over this sort of trip
runners.name: Norman Fletcher
runners.spotlight: Hasn't fired as he can this season but he's well handicapped on form that wasn't that long ago; back from a break and hasn't had many chances over this sort of trip.

runners.comment: Three seconds on the bounce before suffering a very heavy fall at Newbury yesterday
runners.name: Nowmelad
runners.spotlight: Three seconds on the bounce before suffering a very heavy fall when still in contention at Newbury yesterday.

runners.breeder: Haras Du Hoguenet & Mr Gilles Le Baron
runners.comment: Novice win has worked out well and he wasn't far away on his handicap debut
runners.name: In The Age
runners.spotlight: Point/bumper winner; the form of his novice win at Catterick has worked out well (2m3f, good) and he wasn't beaten far on his handicap debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, soft) despite a late mistake; how significant it is that Harry Atkins (aboard for both those runs; can do this weight) switches to Knickerbockerglory remains to be seen; respected nevertheless.

runners.comment: Placed in handicap hurdles and gets in off a lower mark for this debut over fences
runners.name: Paddys Policy
runners.spotlight: Only won a maiden over hurdles but was placed in two handicaps and gets in off a lower mark for this debut over fences (second in his only point); worth considering.

runners.comment: Has got closer in each of her three runs over fences, last time beaten 5.5l at Warwick
runners.name: Epinephrine
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler; has got closer in each of her three runs over fences, last time beaten 5.5l at Warwick (2m, good to soft); could well have more to offer.

runners.comment: He was too free last time at Southwell and now goes in cheekpieces
runners.name: Disguisedlimit
runners.spotlight: Two seconds and a third over fences for this yard, from 2m to 2m4f; had a couple of blips as well but he was too free last time at Southwell and now goes in cheekpieces (tongue tied last time); possibilities.

runners.comment: Beaten when falling here last month but ran well for a good way
runners.name: Jiair Madrik
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Catterick in January (1m7f, soft), his third start after a long absence; beaten when falling here last month but ran well for a good way; can win off this mark by the looks.

runners.comment: Won last month but his run 20 days ago was a reminder of his inconsistency
runners.name: Dj Pete
runners.spotlight: Won narrowly at Ffos Las last month (2m, heavy) but his tailed-off run back there 20 days ago was a reminder of his inconsistency; he's capable, and on this ground, but comes with risks.

16:30.race_name: Tom Jones Live At Chester Racecourse Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Could raise his game now handicapping, especially back on this sort of ground
runners.name: Titanium Ring
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in a bumper (good to soft) and competitive when falling two out in a Uttoxeter maiden hurdle (2m, heavy); below that level since but did lose a shoe last time and could raise his game now handicapping, especially on this better ground.

runners.comment: Back up in trip and off a reduced mark, there's some cause for optimism
runners.name: Supreme Yeats
runners.owner: The Old Stag Racing Sy Partnership
runners.spotlight: Arrives in no sort of form but he has been running over 2m and he's won over nearly 3m in the past; back up in trip and off a reduced mark, there's some cause for optimism.

runners.comment: Poor this season but won easily here only four starts back last April
runners.name: Rock Hurley
runners.spotlight: Bang out of form in his last three races but only four starts back last April he won as he liked around here (good to soft) off 5lb higher; couldn't put a line through him.

runners.comment: Won in Ireland; two fair runs over hurdles for this yard before pulling up over fences
runners.name: Love Me
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap hurdle for Henry de Bromhead whom she left for £5,500; they were perfectly respectable runs over hurdles for this yard in the winter and her non-completion last time (after wind surgery) was over fences; couldn't dismiss.

runners.comment: Modest run last time but wasn't far away in his two previous runs
runners.name: Golden Identity
runners.spotlight: Modest run last time but wasn't far away in his two previous runs after a wind operation and there are races in him off this mark.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De La Haie Neuve
runners.comment: Encouraging fourth at Ludlow latest and handicaps were always going to be more like it
runners.name: Fanny Moon
runners.spotlight: Signs of progress when fourth behind a useful winner in a 2m Ludlow novice last month (2m, soft) and handicaps were always going to be more like it; respected.

runners.comment: Has been showing enough to believe he'll pay his way in handicaps; had wind surgery
runners.name: Joeybottles
runners.spotlight: All runs on good to soft or soft; third in a bumper and has been showing enough to believe he'll pay his way in handicaps, last time finishing just ahead of Titanium Ring at Ludlow; likely contender after wind surgery.

runners.comment: Couldn't make a compelling case on this handicap debut and others preferred
runners.name: Noble George
runners.spotlight: Couldn't make a compelling case on this handicap debut and others preferred even if he is backed in the first-time cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Perhaps flattered behind useful novices here last time as they went no pace
runners.name: Ayyadieh
