runners.spotlight: As at Carlisle on his reappearance, they were decent horses he chased home in a novice here last time, though likely he was flattered to be beaten 14l when they went no pace; should do better now into handicaps.

runners.comment: A lot more exposed than many in here but he's been in cracking form for a while now
runners.name: Eric Carmen
runners.spotlight: A lot more exposed than many in here but he's been in cracking form since returning from an absence and his defeat at Leicester was no backward step (2m4f, good to soft); firmly in the mix.

13:43.race_name: Midnite Are Upping The Betting Game Apprentice Handicap

runners.comment: Bolted up over C&D on stable debut ten days ago; up 10lb but it might not be enough
runners.name: Tuscan Point
runners.spotlight: 0-15 for Richard Fahey but he provided Adam Kirby with the perfect start to his training career when routing his rivals over C&D ten days ago; hit with a 10lb rise but it might not be enough to prevent the follow up.

runners.comment: 0-15 but he has been threatening, including over C&D last week; frame claims again
runners.name: Bullington Bry
runners.spotlight: 15-race maiden; solid effort over C&D last week (second run in cheekpieces) and closely matched with Mount Ruapehu; should give his running once again.

runners.comment: C&D win last week on just his second run for new stable; 2lb rise not insurmountable
runners.name: Mount Ruapehu
runners.spotlight: Trained in Ireland when winning a 6f handicap at Newcastle in December; good run on his stable debut last month (5f) and he stepped up on that when winning a C&D handicap last week (Bullington Bry and Amerjeeet in behind); 2lb rise shouldn't prevent a big run.

runners.comment: Met trouble here last week but overall record suggests he's one to tread carefully with
runners.name: Amerjeet
runners.spotlight: More than capable of winning races at this level but he has a poor strike-rate and hasn't always looked enthusiastic under pressure; can't judge him too harshly on latest C&D fifth (finished behind two of today's rivals) as he was short of room on a few occasions from 2f out; others still more appealing for the win.

runners.comment: Failed to fire at Wolverhampton last week (7f) and now tried in headgear
runners.name: Ardaddy
runners.spotlight: Ran well on his first three starts for this stable but last week's Wolverhampton effort was disappointing; connections now turn to cheekpieces.

runners.comment: C&D winner; had been in fair form prior to finishing 11l behind Tuscan Point last time
runners.name: Up The Monk
runners.spotlight: C&D winner last summer; doubled his tally when landing a classified event at Chelmsford in January; fair run over C&D on his penultimate start but he was 11l behind Tuscan Point over C&D ten days ago.

runners.comment: 0-22 in Ireland but starts out for her new trainer off a lowly mark; one to consider
runners.name: Moonhall Lass
runners.spotlight: 0-22 in Ireland but she was rated 70 this time last year and starts out for James Owen, who has revived similar types with aplomb, at a low level; entered in three races early next week, for which she would escape a penalty if winning here, and she is an intriguing candidate.

14:20.race_name: Win £250,000 With BetMGM's Golden Goals Handicap

runners.comment: Back-to-back C&D classified wins this month; should go well returned to a handicap
runners.name: Fifty Sent
runners.spotlight: Goes well at the track and he arrives chasing a hat-trick after back-to-back C&D wins in classified company; sneaking up the weights but another bold bid is expected.

runners.comment: Two C&D wins last October and solid efforts in two of three runs this year; each-way shout
runners.name: Heretic
runners.spotlight: Won two C&D handicaps last October; solid efforts here in two of his three runs this year; in the mix once again.

runners.comment: C&D win when last seen in December; up 5lb but he should give it another good go
runners.name: Ribston Pippin
runners.spotlight: Strong at the finish when winning a similar C&D handicap in December; up 5lb for his troubles but the form is solid enough for the level and he should remain competitive.

runners.comment: Newcastle win off this mark on New Year's Day; should be arriving on the scene late
runners.name: Trais Fluors
runners.spotlight: Slow starter who celebrated turning 12 by seeing off his rivals in a 1m handicap at Newcastle on New Year's Day; back to that mark today and he should be arriving on the scene late.

runners.comment: On a handy mark and more encouragement last month when visored for the first time
runners.name: Mr Fustic
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on last winter's AW form and there were more encouraging signs from him when third at Chelmsford four weeks ago (visored first time); got loose before the start and withdrawn at Newcastle two weeks ago; chance if building on the latest run.

runners.comment: 0-15 but placed in 4 of 8 starts for Tony Carroll, including C&D; not straightforward
runners.name: Volendam
runners.spotlight: 15-race maiden but she has been placed in four of her eight starts for Tony Carroll, including twice over C&D; hasn't always looked straightforward under pressure though.

runners.comment: Improved for slow turf in the 2nd half of 2025; further progress necessary to take this
runners.name: Dinah Myte
runners.spotlight: Progressive on slow turf in the second half of 2025, including a 1m win at Bath; even that effort will need bettering if she is to win this after 145 days on the sidelines.

runners.comment: Won off a higher mark in January but she has failed to kick on from that
runners.name: Scenario
runners.spotlight: Now 1lb lower than for her last-gasp success at Wolverhampton in January but that is a result of some modest efforts since; others look safer.

runners.comment: Three-time C&D winner; sharper for her recent return to action; not ruled out
runners.name: Create
runners.owner: Dixon Wylam M Baldry J&s Harrod
runners.spotlight: Blows hot and cold but her three AW wins have all come over C&D and her recent return from a break should have sharpened her up; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Struggled last year; down in weights & will appreciate return to AW but not a solid option
runners.name: Coverbridge
runners.spotlight: Struggled for this yard in 2025; down in the weights and should appreciate returning to Tapeta but still not an obvious winner.

runners.comment: Back to form with a close 3rd at Wolverhampton 19 days ago; stays 1m; should go well
runners.name: Conquest Of Power
runners.spotlight: Back to form when a close third of ten at Wolverhampton 19 days ago (6f; visored); still has plenty of handicapping scope and the booking of Tom Marquand is a positive; back up in trip with cheekpieces returning; contender.

14:53.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (GBB) (Div I)

runners.comment: Well beaten in a Wetherby bumper in December and a Newcastle novice (1m) last month
runners.name: August Spring
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in a Wetherby bumper in December and a Newcastle novice (1m) last month.

runners.comment: Dictated the pace when springing a 28-1 surprise at Kempton last September; more to come
runners.name: Timber Twelve
runners.spotlight: Overcame a wide stall when springing a 28-1 surprise in a 1m novice at Kempton 197 days ago; that race has thrown up several winners and he did it in good style but he did enjoy a tactical advantage; the penalty asks more of him but he shouldn't be underestimated.

runners.comment: Fourth of six, beaten 5.75l, in a 7f maiden at Wolverhampton on debut; much more required
runners.name: Clatford
runners.spotlight: Ran to a modest level when fourth of six in a 7f maiden at Wolverhampton three weeks ago; open to improvement but it is essential.

runners.comment: Promising debut at Kempton last summer before stiff task on 2nd run; 1m will suit; chance
runners.name: Flash Kozo
runners.owner: D Bevan And Mrs D Bevan
runners.spotlight: He made an encouraging start to his career when fourth of ten in a 7f novice at Kempton last August; stiff task in a sales race at the Curragh one month later; stepping up in trip should suit and he is open to improvement this year.

runners.comment: 125-1 and always behind in a C&D novice six weeks ago; hard to recommend
runners.name: Cobalt Comet
runners.spotlight: 125-1 and always behind in a C&D novice six weeks ago; hard to recommend.

runners.comment: Promising 2nd over C&D six weeks ago when still looking green; capable of further progress
runners.name: Saint Of The Sea
runners.spotlight: Down the field in a Newbury novice on last summer's debut (6f; attracted support); ran well for second over C&D on his return to action six weeks ago, still looking in need of the experience when coming under pressure; should continue to progress.

runners.comment: Modest form when 5th of 7 in a 1m maiden at Lingfield 16 days ago; will do better in time
runners.name: Floating Market
runners.spotlight: Recorded an RPR of 50 when finishing fifth of seven in a 1m maiden at Lingfield 16 days ago; should do better in time but she will need a good jolt of improvement to trouble the principals.

runners.comment: 21,000gns yearling; sister to Atlantic Gamble (RPR 89); fair standard to aim at on debut
runners.name: Luscious Lil
runners.spotlight: 21,000gns yearling; eighth foal; sister to 1m/8.6f winner Atlantic Gamble (including AW; RPR 89), half-sister to Polish 1m4f winner Natanielka; dam unraced half-sister to 1m Group 3 winner Fire Ship; has a fair standard to aim on debut and only of interest if backed.

runners.comment: Half-sister to a 1m2f winner out of a 2m AW winner; likely a longer-term prospect
runners.name: Love Fresh
runners.spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to 1m2f winner Lechuga Lad (RPR 77); dam 2m AW winner (69); stable's newcomers usually better for a run.

15:28.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (GBB) (Div II)

runners.comment: Disappointing when only fifth at Newcastle; chance on previous form but must bounce back
runners.name: Portman Blue
runners.spotlight: All three runs at 7f; bit disappointing when only fifth of nine at Newcastle (3-1; slowly away) nine days ago; previous form would give him a squeak but he needs to bounce back.

runners.comment: Never the slightest threat at long odds in two runs over 1m; hard to fancy
runners.name: Sweetstevie
runners.spotlight: Never the slightest threat at long odds in two runs over 1m on this course; hard to fancy.

runners.comment: 36,000gns yearling; bred to be useful and a fascinating newcomer
runners.name: Alembic
runners.spotlight: 36,000gns yearling; brother to 1m-1m2f winner Almeric (including 2yo/Listed; RPR 121), half-brother to nine winners including Alla Speranza (1m 2yo/1m2f Group 3; 109) and Altesse (1m3f/1m4f including Listed; 102); dam 1m/10.5f (Listed) winner (105); bred to be useful and a fascinating newcomer.

runners.comment: Best work late on when fifth at Newcastle; improvement expected and impossible to discount
runners.name: Lorton Valley
runners.spotlight: Best work late on when fifth of nine at Newcastle (1m; 12-1) five weeks ago; improvement anticipated and he's impossible to discount.

runners.comment: Beaten 21l into sixth of seven at Chelmsford last week; this is weaker; not written off
runners.name: Tough Date
runners.spotlight: Beaten 21l into sixth of seven at Chelmsford (1m; 12-1) last Thursday; needs to have learned a lot in a short space of time but this is a bit weaker and he can't be written off entirely.

runners.comment: Clear signs of ability in two runs last season; returns from a break; might be the answer
runners.name: Welbury
runners.spotlight: Clear signs of ability in two runs (6f/7f) last season, racing too freely for his own good (beaten favourite on second occasion); still has potential and now returns from a break; should stay 1m (dam 1m2f winner); might be the answer.

runners.comment: Something to prove after below-par last run but may be suited be this step back up in trip
runners.name: Tommos Ginjaninja
runners.spotlight: Regressive form in three runs to date, left behind from 2f out when fifth over 7f here last time; something to prove after that, although he may be suited be this step back up in distance.

runners.comment: Placed over C&D and at Wolverhampton; may still be unexposed; one of the likelier ones
runners.name: Filly Eilish
runners.spotlight: Has laid the foundations with encouraging placed efforts over C&D and at Wolverhampton (8.6f), second of six in latter; may still be unexposed; one of the likelier ones.

runners.comment: Last of eight here on debut; may not come into her own until tackling handicaps
runners.name: Rocklaw
runners.spotlight: Faded into last of eight over 7f here (28-1) on debut; now fitted with a hood; stablemate of Tommo's Ginjaninja; may not come into her own until tackling handicaps.

16:03.race_name: Bet £10 Get £40 With BetMGM Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Runner-up three times at Chelmsford; sets the standard on form; should be involved again
runners.name: Baandee
runners.spotlight: Runner-up three times, all over this trip at Chelmsford; proving consistent, sets the standard on form and should be involved in the shake-up again.

runners.comment: Debut fifth hasn't worked out all that well; beat only one home next time; bit to prove
runners.name: Irish Incentive
runners.spotlight: Debut fifth at Musselburgh (7f; 12-1) hasn't worked out all that well, and she beat only one home at Chelmsford (1m) three weeks ago; now has something to prove.

runners.comment: Looked green when third at Wolverhampton; could improve a fair bit over this longer trip
runners.name: Ndoto
runners.spotlight: Looked green when 7l third of six at Wolverhampton (6f; 22-1) 18 days ago, fading after making headway; bred to be suited by 7f+ and could improve a fair bit.

runners.comment: Third three times; probably needed most recent run and now should be cherry ripe
runners.name: Tenzi
runners.spotlight: Has finished third on all three starts; her RPR has dropped each time but she probably needed the run after eight months off at Wolverhampton (6f) on latest; should be cherry ripe now and this step back up in trip is a plus.

runners.comment: 18,000gns yearling; wouldn't have to be anything special to make an impact on debut
runners.name: Curtain Caller
runners.spotlight: 18,000gns yearling; Showcasing half-sister to five winners including Legionario (1m-12.5f including French AW Listed; RPR 103), Manolito (1m/8.6f AW; 80) and Tayara (French 11.5f); dam unraced; wouldn't have to be anything special to make an impact on debut.

runners.comment: Always on the back foot after being hampered at the start on debut; likely to do better
runners.name: Wadirumm
runners.spotlight: Attracted some support (12-1 into 7-1) on Wolverhampton debut over this trip 18 days ago, but was always on the back foot after being hampered at the start; likely to do better.

16:38.race_name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap

runners.comment: Hugely talented sprinter but he has refused to race in three of his last five starts
runners.name: Clarendon House
runners.spotlight: High-class sprinter on turf and AW; his two C&D wins have both been mighty performances and there is no doubt he has the raw ability to give the weight away to today's opponents; sadly he has become a nightmare at the start, refusing to race in three of his last five runs; can't be supported with confidence; stable run four here.

runners.comment: Group 3/Listed success last year; quiet in the Middle East this year; high in weights
runners.name: Spartan Arrow
runners.owner: Hambleton Racing Ltd XXXI And Partner
runners.spotlight: Four wins in 2025, notably a Group 3 at Dundalk in October; struggled in two runs in the Middle East this year and he is 4lb higher than when second in last summer's Dash at Epsom, his most recent run in a handicap.

runners.comment: C&D winner; now high in the weights following a Listed win in France last summer
runners.name: Miss Attitude
runners.spotlight: She made a winning seasonal debut in a Class 3 handicap over C&D 12 months ago; found some improvement in the second half of that campaign, including a Listed win in France last August (5f, good); looks high in the weights ahead of her return to action.

runners.comment: Smart sprinter who hasn't run a bad race on AW; sold for 37,000gns in October; contender
runners.name: Kylian
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Xii & Mrs G Cowell
runners.spotlight: Four wins and a second from his five AW starts (the defeat came in his one C&D run); landed a Listed win on turf in Germany last summer; sold out of Archie Watson's stable for 37,000gns in October; this mark not beyond him if ready to go after six months off; cheekpieces the headgear of choice today; one of four runners for Robert Cowell.

runners.comment: Impressive C&D win on recent stable debut; up 6lb but he did look good
runners.name: Gaeli
runners.spotlight: Ex-Italian sprinter; nibbled at big prices prior to his smooth C&D win on stable debut 17 days ago; this is a stronger race and he is now 6lb higher, but he did look good.

runners.comment: Conditions to suit but he will need a career best to take this back from 167 days off
runners.name: Against The Wind
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; thumped ten rivals in a C&D handicap last July and ran well off his revised mark (1lb lower today) back here in September; found the Group 1 Abbaye too hot to handle when last seen in October; won after a break last spring but he was well ahead of his mark then and that probably isn't the case now.

runners.comment: Took form to a new level with ready Newcastle win last month; up 7lb but can't discount
runners.name: Fahrenheit Seven
runners.spotlight: Progressive sprinter for Mark Usher; down the field in the Ayr Gold Cup on his stable debut last September but he was back on the up with a comfortable Newcastle success six weeks ago (5f; ridden by Tom Marquand); although visually impressive (good Topspeed figure too), the form has taken some knocks and he will need another career best if he is to defy a 7lb rise.

runners.comment: Ended 2025 on the up and showed better form when 2nd in Listed race last month; chance
runners.name: Clearpoint
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 on the up and he improved again when second in the Listed Hever Stakes at Lingfield four weeks ago; a 3lb rise demands extra but this speedy sort shouldn't be discounted.

runners.comment: Progressive 3yo in 2025; C&D winner who could have more to offer this year; not ruled out
runners.name: Brosay
runners.spotlight: C&D winner as a 2yo; blinkers prompted some progress last summer, winning 6f handicaps at Windsor and Ascot; ended that campaign with a lesser effort on testing ground at Doncaster but he appeals as the type to enjoy another good year as a 4yo; needs luck in running and wouldn't want to leave himself with too much to do (has missed the break in the past).

runners.comment: On a good mark and conditions won't faze him; back from an absence and likely best watched
runners.name: Vintage Clarets
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner down the years and he is 3lb lower than when second over C&D last September; first time out perhaps not the time to catch him though.

runners.comment: Condititions to suit and likely to run his race; others appeal as being better handicapped
runners.name: Rhythm N Hooves
runners.spotlight: Two C&D wins last year and he is a reliable sprinter in the main; no match for his stablemate Fahrenheit Seven at Newcastle six weeks ago and it would be surprising if a few of these weren't better handicapped.

runners.comment: Conditions to suit but he had no answer when Gaeli swept past him 17 days ago
runners.name: Ziggys Triton
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a pair of C&D wins; came up just shy in his hat-trick bid in January; respectable third here 17 days ago but he was left trailing in Gaeli's wake on that occasion.

17:13.race_name: Daily Profit Boosts At betmgm.co.uk Fillies' Handicap

runners.breeder: J Cypres N Cypres & Earl Ecurie D
runners.comment: 0-6 in Britain and inconsistent but has posted two good efforts this year (one here)
runners.name: Lilly Lux
runners.spotlight: 0-6 in Britain and not very consistent but went close here (1m3f) in January and also ran well when fourth of 12 over that trip at Kempton this month; 1lb lower now; no surprise if she features.

runners.comment: Career-best form when scoring at Wolverhampton last month; can remain very competitive
runners.name: Little Miss India
runners.spotlight: Career-best form when holding on for narrow win at Wolverhampton (1m4f; front pair clear) under Ashley Lewis last month; ought to remain very competitive after 4lb rise.

runners.comment: Second in three of her six handicaps; absent since struggling on heavy turf in September
runners.name: Solar Pass
runners.spotlight: Won 1m Polytrack maiden at start of 2025 and was runner-up in three of her six subsequent handicaps (1m3f-1m6f); absent since struggling on heavy turf in September, though, and will need to hit the ground running to have any chance off current mark.

runners.comment: Enjoyed run of the race when fourth at big odds at Lingfield last month; others preferred
runners.name: Green Sky
runners.spotlight: Belied 100-1 odds when fourth of 12 on last month's Flat return at Lingfield (1m5f) but enjoyed the run of the race in that steadily run contest and the form is not reliable.

runners.comment: Clearcut C&D winner this month and now 2-3 in handicaps; makes obvious appeal
runners.name: Velvet Red
runners.spotlight: Kept on well for clearcut C&D success ten days ago and is now 2-3 in handicaps; moves up from Class 6 but could still have significant further improvement to come; makes obvious appeal.

runners.comment: Dual course winner this winter; another good run when third to Velvet Red here recently
runners.name: Hackney Diamonds
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner in cheekpieces during the winter (1m3f/1m4f) and kept on well for third behind Velvet Red over C&D ten days ago; recent 2lb drop helps; can make presence felt again, assuming switch to refitted visor doesn't backfire.

runners.breeder: Brook Stud Bloodstock & W A Tinkler
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on both 1m starts this year and not bred for this much longer trip
runners.name: Lady Justice
runners.owner: J W Parry And Mrs C Shekells
runners.spotlight: Disappointing filly who was soundly beaten over 1m on her first two appearances this year; not bred to benefit from this big hike up in trip, and could be considered only if lively in the betting.

runners.comment: In good form but is 2lb wrong and will find this tougher than recent assignments
runners.name: Late Claim
runners.spotlight: Second on three of her four starts since opening account at Lingfield (1m5f) in December but was in a basement-grade classified at Wolverhampton (1m4f) last time and has more on her plate from 2lb out of the weights here.

17:43.race_name: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Handicap

runners.breeder: North Cheshire Trading And Storage Ltd
runners.comment: Not one to rely upon but probably still on good mark after last month's win in new visor
runners.name: Grabajabba
runners.spotlight: Seemingly boosted by first-time visor when coming from off the pace to score at Wolverhampton (7f) last month; not in same form on latest outing and not one to rely upon heavily but probably still on a good mark.

runners.comment: Got back on track with good second at Newcastle this month; remains on a workable mark
runners.name: Blazing Son
runners.spotlight: Lost ground at the start in three consecutive races before getting back on track with second at Newcastle (7f) this month; also suited by this track and remains on a workable mark; player if he gets away promptly again.

runners.comment: Signed off for Richard Hannon with good third in October; market may guide on stable debut
runners.name: Great
runners.spotlight: 1-7 when trained by Richard Hannon, signing off with pretty good third at Kempton (7f) in October; changed hands for 25,000gns soon afterwards and has been gelded; makes stable debut after 171-day break but with Tom Marquand a good booking; market may guide.

runners.comment: Won at York last summer but absent since low-key run on soft turf in September
runners.name: Chesneys Charm
runners.owner: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd
runners.spotlight: Scored off 1lb lower in first-time cheekpieces at York (7f, good) last summer and is also suited by Tapeta but we haven't seen him since a low-key run on soft turf in September.

runners.comment: Not much has gone to plan this year but he's well handicapped on autumn Wolverhampton form
runners.name: Thurso
runners.spotlight: Not much has gone to plan since the turn of the year and he's drawn wide today but he moves back up to his optimum trip after two 6f runs (lost ground at the start both times) and is well handicapped if judged on his 7f Wolverhampton form from the autumn.

runners.comment: Below best this year but he's effective over this C&D and too well handicapped to rule out
runners.name: Al Muqdad
runners.spotlight: Below best this year, managing only sixth of eight in refitted cheekpieces (now removed) at Newcastle (7f) a fortnight ago, but he's effective over this C&D, well drawn and too well handicapped to rule out.

runners.breeder: Mr & Mrs D R Guest & Mr & Mrs Jpm Main
runners.comment: Six-time AW winner in first half of 2025; back on a good mark but wide draw a negative
runners.name: Ash Wednesday
runners.spotlight: Won six times on Tapeta (twice over C&D) in first half of 2025, despite his tendency to race too freely; back on a good mark now and bettered a low-key reappearance run when respectable fifth over C&D ten days ago but outside draw a negative today.

runners.comment: Eight-race maiden who was out of form when last seen in the autumn and seems best over 1m
runners.name: Sea Suite
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who was out of form when last seen in the autumn and has shown his best form over 1m; cheekpieces removed after one use; others have much less to prove.

runners.comment: Placed at 80-1 in a novice but well beaten on subsequent handicap debut; back from break
runners.name: Stoneywell
runners.spotlight: Belied 80-1 odds when placed in Leicester novice (7f, good) in October, his third start, but was well-beaten 50-1 shot on handicap debut at the following month (raced too freely); returns with a hood added; remains unexposed but needs to prove he can cope with a mark this high.

runners.comment: Absent since Chelmsford second in February 2025; market helpful on stable/handicap debut
runners.name: Too Sweet
runners.spotlight: 0-3 when owned by Amo Racing but the form of his close second at Chelmsford (7f) in February 2025 was very well advertised by the winner afterwards; joined new stable for 5,000gns in the autumn; makes stable/handicap debut after 392-day absence but well worth a glance in the betting.

runners.comment: Dual course winner this year; below form last time but remains very much of interest
runners.name: King Of York
runners.owner: A Baker D Slack M Wilson & Partners
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner (1m/7f) this year, following a layoff; managed only sixth when favourite here (1m) 11 days ago but has a big role to play from the inside stall if quickly back in the groove.

runners.comment: Emphatic winner off much reduced mark at Wolverhampton last week; must be considered
runners.name: Habrdi
runners.owner: Mrs S D Pearson And Mrs R Carr
runners.spotlight: Has dropped a long way down the weights over the last year or so but took advantage at Wolverhampton (7f) last week, quickening up well for an emphatic success; 7lb higher and up in grade here but can drop in from his wide draw and needs to be taken very seriously.

17:00.race_name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Returns after another lengthy absence and she has something to prove back on AW
runners.name: Cabrera
runners.owner: Hot To Trot Racing 1 And Mrs David Egan
runners.spotlight: Consistent and steadily progressive in 2024 until below par in cheekpieces in final run that year; well held again on Ripon reappearance (1m4f, good) last April and she's been back on the sidelines since then; has something to prove after another lengthy absence and her only AW run was on her debut.

runners.comment: Only 1lb higher than for his last success but needs to raise his game back in trip
runners.name: Machete
runners.spotlight: Won over 1m2f here in December but he's not made an impact in last three runs and was beaten 5l when third at Chelmsford (1m6f) last time; now only 1lb higher than for last success but he needs to raise his game back in trip.

runners.comment: Improver who went close on handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f) latest; big player
runners.name: Rastnet
runners.spotlight: Form figures of 5221 at novice level and she found more progress upped to 1m4f when going close on handicap debut at Wolverhampton last month; up 2lb but she stayed on well for a clear second last time and that form has been boosted by the third and fourth since; big player.

runners.comment: Three wins this winter and he ran another solid race when second at Wolverhampton latest
runners.name: Charlies Choice
runners.spotlight: Reliable 6yo, who won three times (1m4f/1m5f) during a busy spell this winter and he ran another solid race when runner-up at Wolverhampton (1m6f) last Friday; should go well again on this drop back in trip and he's respected with Hollie Doyle booked.

runners.comment: Won by 14l at Catterick last summer; had wind op since; interesting on handicap debut
runners.name: Alther Walden
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in his first two runs last summer before a runaway win on the step up to 1m4f at Catterick (good to firm) in August; returns after wind surgery but he looks on a fair opening mark and is an interesting contender on this switch to AW.

runners.comment: Three wins including over C&D; returns after 238 days off but he needs checking in market
runners.name: LEagle Aid
runners.spotlight: Completed a double when dead-heating at Chester (12.3f, good) last July but he was well below form at York in his final run last summer; returns after 238 days off but he still looks on a workable mark and his penultimate win was over C&D; needs watching in the market on this drop back in grade.

runners.comment: Record of 2-5 but she needs to bounce back after a flop at Kempton last month
runners.name: Selenic
runners.owner: Sir F Brooke & Sir R Pilkington
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-4 when landing a handicap here (1m2f) in January but she flopped when favourite at Kempton (1m3f) last month; bit to prove after that but a wide trip didn't help and she probably still has untapped potential; dangerous if she can bounce back.

17:30.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Half-brother to four winners but this looks a tough starting point
runners.name: Balmoral Boy
runners.spotlight: 50,000euros foal, 55,000euros yearling; gelded half-brother to four winners including Baron Samedi (1m2f-2m including French Group 2/US Grade 2; RPR 118), Havanagreattime (6f/7f including AW; 97) and Mukhaater (Swedish 1m3f/1m4f); dam unplaced 7f (48); has fair taget to aim at on debut and he could be one for later on.

runners.comment: Half-brother to seven winners but he made a low-key start at big price over C&D last month
runners.name: Haltonwood
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to seven winners but he made a low-key start at a big price over C&D (10l fifth of ten) last month; should know more this time but he needs plenty of improvement to make an impact.

runners.comment: Made promising start at Wolverhampton two weeks ago; respected for in-form yard
runners.name: Showcasing Star
runners.spotlight: First foal of a maiden, herself a daughter of Oaks runner-up Something Exciting; held in second of three on debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f) two weeks ago but he gave it a good shot from the front and was a long way clear of the third; has claims if he can build on that and he's respected for an in-form yard.

runners.comment: Turned over at 2-9 at Wolverhampton but he sets standard on that clear second; key player
runners.name: Starglow
runners.spotlight: 120,000euros yearling; closely related to a Group 3 winner and half-brother to two Listed scorers; turned over at 2-9 on Wolverhampton debut (7f) last month but he looked inexperienced and kept on well to finish a clear second; sets the standard and he's open to progress upped in trip.

runners.comment: Remote fifth on Hamilton debut last summer and he's best watched on return for new yard
runners.name: The Floors Munky
runners.spotlight: 50-1 on Hamilton debut (8.3f, good to firm) last August and he faded into a remote fifth of six; left Iain Jardine since then and he's best watched on return for new yard.

runners.comment: Yard was 0-18 in novice events last year and he's best watched on debut
runners.name: Thunder Rush
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; gelded half-brother to winners Thunder Roar (7f/1m; RPR 103) and Not Now Nathaniel (1m4f Flat, 76; and bumper/2m1f hurdle); dam unplaced 7f/8.6f 2yo (60), out of Italian 1m Listed winner; yard 0-18 in novice events last year and he's best watched on debut.

runners.comment: 510,000gns yearling; interesting newcomer and he needs a close look in the market
runners.name: Wareeth
runners.spotlight: 50,000euros foal, 510,000gns yearling; sixth foal; brother to 7f 2yo AW winner Shah (RPR 93), closely related to 11.6f winner Aljalela (66), half-brother to Listed-placed 7.5f AW/1m turf 2yo winner Ursuly (93); dam 1m 2yo Group 3 winner (stayed 12.5f; 105); interesting newcomer and he needs a close look in the market.

runners.comment: This looks a tough starting point and she could be one for further down the line
runners.name: The Bitters
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam 7f-9.5f winner (including AW; RPR 76), out of unraced half-sister to 5f 2yo Group 2 winner Sand Vixen (dam of UAE 1m1f Group 1 winner Dream Castle) and 6f Listed winner So Will I; this looks a tough starting point and she could be one for further down the line.

18:00.race_name: Win £250,000 With BetMGM's Golden Goals Novice Stakes

runners.comment: Has good standard to aim at on belated debut and he is best watched
runners.name: Billyjoegold
runners.spotlight: Eleventh foal; half-brother to winners Bobby Joe Leg (prolific 6f/7f AW; RPR 78), Mostashreqah (7f AW 2yo; 73), Dad's Girl (5f 2yo; 66) and Brother Dave (7f AW; 62); dam 6f winner (including AW; 93); has good standard to aim at on belated debut and he is best watched.

runners.comment: Well-held fifth in both starts and has plenty to find on this drop in trip
runners.name: Porters Song
runners.spotlight: Well-held fifth in sole run for Andre Fabre in France and same outcome on stable debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f) on Monday; still early days for this well-bred 4yo but he needs a transformation on this drop in trip.

runners.comment: Sets a good standard on his second at Doncaster last spring; big player on his return
runners.name: Recency Bias
runners.spotlight: 60,000gns yearling by Havana Grey; made a promising start when fourth at Wolverhampton last March and he built on that when runner-up at Doncaster (7f, good) later that month; been absent since then but he sets a good standard on his comeback and yard has been firing in winners recently.

runners.comment: Sole run was promising second in France in November 2024; needs close look on stable debut
runners.name: Zatsgood
runners.spotlight: Brother to 6f/1m winner Delaware (including Group 3; RPR 112); sole run was November 2024 but that was a promising second at Chantilly (9.5f, soft) and the form has been well advertised since; left Andre Fabre for 28,000gns and he needs a close look on comeback for new yard; been gelded.

runners.comment: Has plenty to find on this drop to 7f and handicaps will be more suitable
runners.name: Finally Escaped
runners.spotlight: Well-held second of three on debut here (1m) last month and she failed to build on that when a remote sixth at Southwell (1m3f); took a strong hold last time but she has plenty to find on this drop to 7f and handicaps will be more suitable.

runners.comment: Dual point and hurdle winner and this is a tough task on her belated Flat debut
runners.name: Pop The Question
runners.spotlight: 8yo mare who has won two points (3m) and a maiden hurdle (2m4f), but she was pulled up on her last run in May and this is a tough task on her belated Flat debut.

18:30.race_name: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Handicap

runners.comment: Still unexposed after only five runs but he needs improvement back up in trip
runners.name: Norcross Brow
runners.spotlight: 20-1 second on handicap debut at Southwell (1m, Tapeta) in January but that was behind an emphatic winner and he was only fourth of seven here (7f) last month; remains unexposed after only five runs but he needs improvement back up in trip.

runners.comment: No impact in four runs so far and he needs to raise his game after wind surgery
runners.name: Kameko Fever
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
runners.spotlight: Beaten around 8l in his three qualifying runs and was never dangerous when fourth of seven on handicap debut over C&D (28-1) last month; been gelded since that last run but he needs to find more after a short break.

runners.comment: Wolverhampton winner but he's been out of sorts in both runs for current yard; had wind op
runners.name: Smartanck
runners.spotlight: Won a Wolverhampton nursery (7f, Tapeta) on his penultimate run for Richard Hughes but he's been out of sorts in two runs for new yard this winter; had wind surgery last month but he needs a major revival back up in trip.

runners.breeder: W Neumann Earl Haras Du Logis & Mr
